title: Holocropolis

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: It is you! You are welcome to the Lowtown Holocropolis! I am so pleased to see you! Here is a tissue! I need a tissue!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is you! You are welcome to the Lowtown Holocropolis! I am so pleased to see you! Here is a tissue! I need a tissue!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: It is you. You are welcome to the Lowtown Holocropolis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is you. You are welcome to the Lowtown Holocropolis.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I am allowed to say that I am well! My logic relay is efficiently logical!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am allowed to say that I am well! My logic relay is efficiently logical!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Can I help you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I help you!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: We have many empty resting places. You wish to upload a dead human relative?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have many empty resting places. You wish to upload a dead human relative?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Normally there would be a charge of 100 Lims. But I will waive that! For you! Please proceed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Normally there would be a charge of 100 Lims. But I will waive that! For you! Please proceed.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: There is a charge of 100 Lims. Do you wish to proceed?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is a charge of 100 Lims. Do you wish to proceed?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Please return when you have the funds. Thank for you visiting Lowtown Holocropolis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please return when you have the funds. Thank for you visiting Lowtown Holocropolis.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: There. I have encoded her name onto the plaque and uploaded her memory. Now, she can rest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There. I have encoded her name onto the plaque and uploaded her memory. Now, she can rest.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Should we tell Samuel, so he can turn this place into a place of worship?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should we tell Samuel, so he can turn this place into a place of worship?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How are you, Rosetta?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How are you, Rosetta?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Glad to hear it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glad to hear it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need a favor. A plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need a favor. A plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need a favor. A plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need a favor. A plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Something like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need a plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need a plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need a plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need a plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. I promised.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I promised.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have that right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have that right now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have that right now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have that right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're looking good, too!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're looking good, too!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Rather a ... distant friend!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rather a ... distant friend!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. It was his order that caused her death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. It was his order that caused her death.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No. It was his order that caused her death.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No. It was his order that caused her death.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell him so he can apologize.
